explanation: Highclere was home to the 5th Earl of Carnarvon, who funded Howard Carter's dig that found the tomb of Tutankhamun in 1922.

claims.text: Highclere Castle in Hampshire was the main filming location for the house in Downton Abbey.
Bridgerton, Brideshead Revisited and Pride and Prejudice did not use Highclere Castle as their main house; Brideshead Revisited used Castle Howard.
Highclere Castle was the home of the 5th Earl of Carnarvon.
The 5th Earl of Carnarvon funded Howard Carter's excavation, which found Tutankhamun's tomb in 1922.
